author: B. C. Morton
title: WHoH-TV releases new programming for March 2026
text:
WHoH-TV announced on Apr. 8 its latest lineup of programs and meetings available for viewing from March 2026.
The announcement is relevant to residents who rely on WHoH-TV for updates on local government, community events, and cultural programs.
The station’s recent programming includes videos of several key meetings such as the Board of Trustees sessions held on March 3, March 17, a special meeting at MacEachron Park on March 18, and a budget work session on March 23. The Planning Board meeting from March 19 and the Zoning Board meeting from March 26 are also available to watch.
In addition to government meetings, WHoH-TV has released recordings of community events including an Irish Sing-a-Long with Sheila Noonan, the Hastings Recreations Basketball Awards Ceremony for 2026, “Sundays at the Library” featuring Billy Altman discussing Positively Fourth & Mercer, a Senior St. Patrick’s Day Luncheon with music by Sounds Familiar, Eggstravaganza 2026, and “Talkin’ Bout the Revolution” with Todd Braisted.
Community members are encouraged to contact WHoH-TV with comments or suggestions for future programming via email at WHoH-TV@hohny.gov or visit their website at http://hohny.gov .
